name: Calendar: Sync Imported Feed

description.en: Fetch one iCalendar source now and apply its changes to this team's imported updates. The result reports how many events were created, updated, archived, or unchanged so an agent can confirm the synchronization outcome.
description.de: Ruft eine iCalendar-Quelle sofort ab und übernimmt Änderungen in die importierten Updates dieses Teams. Das Ergebnis zeigt erstellte, aktualisierte, archivierte und unveränderte Ereignisse, damit ein Agent die Synchronisierung bestätigen kann.

bot: Use this when the user asks to refresh a specific imported calendar source immediately. List feeds first when the source ID is unknown; this does not change the daily sync schedule.

inputs.name: Feed ID

description.en: Identifier of the imported calendar source

inputs.bot: The feed ID from list imported calendar feeds.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug that owns this calendar source

inputs.bot: The slug of the team that owns this calendar source. Omit it to use the current team.
